title: Zig 0.16: a duration parser and formatter with a precise error model (zig build test), on a machine without Zig

verify.command: set -e; if [ ! -x /opt/zig/zig ]; then apk add --no-cache xz >/dev/null; wget -qO- https://ziglang.org/download/0.16.0/zig-$(uname -m)-linux-0.16.0.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C /opt/zig --strip-components=1; fi; /opt/zig/zig build test --summary all 2>&1
